recommended_routine.name: Batch Partitioning
recommended_routine.goal: Split intake into coherent run-date batches before vision processing.
algorithms: metadata grouping by capture_date + uploaded_at
duplicate check on source_asset_id
row count expectation check (target 32 for watering-day tomato runs)
recommended_routine.gate: Proceed only when a batch key and candidate run size are identified.

recommended_routine.name: Frame-Type Routing
recommended_routine.goal: Route each photo to the right path before OCR/mapping.
algorithms: quality gate (blur + brightness) to flag recapture rows
single-pot vs multi-pot/context classifier
latest-run hint: Current batch resembles unlabeled watering-day one-pot sequence uploads.
recommended_routine.gate: Rows are labeled as baseline_single_pot, watering_day_sequence, or random_context.

recommended_routine.name: Pot Detection
recommended_routine.goal: Find candidate pot regions per image and estimate per-row pot count.
algorithms: pot bounding-box detector (YOLO/Detectron fine-tuned on local data)
center-priority heuristic for single-pot expected rows
multi-pot branch keeps all candidate boxes with confidence
recommended_routine.gate: At least one pot candidate per tomato-target row, otherwise queue capture review.

recommended_routine.name: Label/OCR Extraction
recommended_routine.goal: Extract pot tag and packet number only from detected label zones.
algorithms: label-region crop via text detector
OCR ensemble (psm variants) on label crop, not full frame
regex parse for pot_tag / packet_tag / numeric candidates
recommended_routine.gate: Return structured tokens with confidence and raw OCR excerpt.

recommended_routine.name: Identity Resolution
recommended_routine.goal: Map pots/plants to canonical database IDs with continuity-first logic.
algorithms: manual pot-series overrides (highest priority)
baseline continuity reconciliation by pot_id
historical/series-map fallback when OCR is weak
sequence inference only for near-complete watering-day batches
recommended_routine.gate: Every tomato-target row has pot_id + variety_name or is explicitly marked review-needed.

recommended_routine.name: Confidence And Review Queue
recommended_routine.goal: Auto-accept high-confidence rows and isolate ambiguous rows.
algorithms: final_status scoring: ready_direct / ready_auto_resolved / review_needed_*
review_stage routing: capture, ocr, mapping
strict run check (expected pot count + duplicates + conflicts)
recommended_routine.gate: Only ready rows publish to main mapping; review rows stay in queue.

recommended_routine.name: Persist And Learn
recommended_routine.goal: Store provenance and improve model thresholds over time.
algorithms: persist resolution_source and mapping notes per row
track per-batch drift metrics (label rate, OCR rate, resolution rate)
feed reviewed corrections back into overrides/training set
recommended_routine.gate: Each completed batch updates drift history and training corpus.
